pages.title: Build Your Own Hamper
pages.body:
Build Your Own Hamper

Tell us the occasion, the number of hampers, a budget, and whether you want bars, dragée, bonbons, or a festive sleeve. We will confirm the edit, a note card, and delivery before you pay.

WhatsApp +91 77778 77253 or write to hello@tryroosha.com.

pages.title: Bulk Order
pages.body:
Bulk Order

Weddings, offices, and festive rounds are quoted on quantity, personalisation, and delivery city. Share your date, headcount, and whether boxes need a name or a logo.

WhatsApp +91 77778 77253 or write to hello@tryroosha.com.

pages.title: Chocolate Tasting
pages.body:
Chocolate Tasting

Roosha can host a small tasting for teams and private celebrations — single-origin bars, dragée, and a bonbon flight. Tell us the city, the group size, and the date you have in mind.
